items.name: calamansi
items.title: Calamansi

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: A Calamansi surface card designed after the NumberTicker slab, featuring 3D spring tilt physics, fractal grain noise, and an interactive light sheen.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An infinite marquee that pauses on hover and fades its edges.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: An odometer-style number that rolls to each new value.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A dock that magnifies the item under the pointer, Mac-style.

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic Island
items.description: A Calamansi surface island designed after the NumberTicker slab, featuring fluid spring layout morphing, fine fractal grain noise, and a frosted glass window.

items.name: task-widget
items.title: Task Widget
items.description: An iOS-inspired glassmorphism widget featuring a live digital clock, dynamic weather status, fine grain noise, and tactile task cards with spring checkmarks.

items.name: morning-widget
items.title: Morning Widget
items.description: A sunrise-gradient card that greets you by name, keeps a live clock with rolling digits, leans towards the pointer and cycles motivational lines with a staged reveal.
